title: Minason - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Minason in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Minason is a physical-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Luck (D), Vitality (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Minason
sections.content:
Location: The Crows - Chromatic Chapelier drop.

Obtained from The Crows - Chromatic Chapelier drop.

sections.title: Is the Minason Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Luck (D), Vitality (C). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
